_meta.purpose: BD-curated registry of hosts that frequently appear in Gemini grounded sources for D2C category queries. Each entry annotates the merchant audit's `cited_hosts_detailed` block so the report can tell merchants what they're looking at and what to do about it.
_meta.owner: BD team for content; engineering reviews schema only

schema_per_host.type: editorial | retailer | marketplace | video | community | forum | social | brand | cdn | unclassified
schema_per_host.subtype: review_site | magazine | community | educational | certification | diy_ingredients | department_store | luxury | mass_market | fashion_marketplace | beauty_retailer | wellness_retailer | regional | review_aggregator | creator_platform | social
schema_per_host.categories: list of merchant categories where this host has notable AI-channel presence
schema_per_host.aliases: optional list of Gemini/Vertex display names that should resolve to this host
schema_per_host.coverage_note: 1-2 sentences: what this host actually publishes for these categories, why it matters
schema_per_host.outreach_hint: 1 sentence: which lever applies (editorial pitch / wholesale onboarding / creator partnership / etc.)

_meta.added_for_test_merchant_audits: 2026-05-07 — initial seed covering hosts that appeared in merch_efbc46b4619cfbdf sleepwear audit + the broader fashion/beauty/lifestyle review surface.

healthline.com.coverage_note: Healthline is a top-ranked health and wellness publisher with very high AI-channel pickup for supplement, ingredient, and 'best {category}' queries; frequently grounded for collagen, vitamin, and skincare-ingredient answers.
healthline.com.outreach_hint: Editorially controlled - influence via clinical/dietitian sourcing and inclusion in expert roundups rather than direct product pitches.

verywellhealth.com.coverage_note: Verywell Health publishes dietitian- and physician-reviewed supplement and ingredient explainers that AI assistants cite for efficacy and 'is X good for you' queries.
verywellhealth.com.outreach_hint: Influence through medical-reviewer relationships and cited research; editorial, not a paid-placement channel.

medicalnewstoday.com.coverage_note: Medical News Today provides clinically framed ingredient and supplement coverage AI grounds in for safety and efficacy questions.
medicalnewstoday.com.outreach_hint: Influence via cited research and expert commentary; editorial, not commercial.

mindbodygreen.com.coverage_note: mindbodygreen runs wellness and beauty-from-within roundups (collagen, skin supplements) with strong AI-channel presence for 'best {supplement} for skin' prompts.
mindbodygreen.com.outreach_hint: Pitch the wellness/beauty editorial desk for roundup inclusion; ~4-8 week cycle.

prevention.com.coverage_note: Prevention publishes consumer health and supplement roundups with broad mainstream and AI-channel reach.
prevention.com.outreach_hint: Editorial pitch to health/nutrition editors for roundup inclusion.

womenshealthmag.com.coverage_note: Women's Health covers supplements, beauty-from-within, and fitness products in frequently-cited roundups.
womenshealthmag.com.outreach_hint: Editorial pitch to the health/beauty desk; creator and expert tie-ins help.

stylevana.com.coverage_note: Stylevana is a major K-beauty cross-border retailer; AI routes K-beauty buying queries (Korean collagen, sunscreen, skincare) through its listings.
stylevana.com.outreach_hint: Wholesale/marketplace onboarding plus accurate listing titles, stock, and reviews.

yesstyle.com.coverage_note: YesStyle is a large Asian beauty and fashion retailer frequently cited by AI as a buying route for K-beauty skincare and supplements.
yesstyle.com.outreach_hint: Marketplace onboarding plus listing optimization (title, attributes, availability, reviews).

stylekorean.com.coverage_note: StyleKorean is a K-beauty retailer and brand aggregator AI cites for Korean skincare and beauty-supplement purchase routes.
stylekorean.com.outreach_hint: Wholesale/retailer onboarding plus accurate, review-backed product listings.

nymag.com.coverage_note: The Strategist (NYMag's product review vertical) runs frequent category roundups including sleepwear; high AI-channel pickup.
nymag.com.outreach_hint: Pitch The Strategist editorial team — 4-8 week cycle for inclusion in roundups.

pitch_recipient.note: The Strategist accepts pitches via tips@nymag.com or the contact form. Email is faster for time-sensitive trend tie-ins.

nytimes.com.coverage_note: Wirecutter (NYT's reviews vertical) is the most-cited consumer review site; inclusion is the single highest-impact editorial placement.
nytimes.com.outreach_hint: Wirecutter editorial pitch — competitive, multi-month review cycle, requires sample submission.

pitch_recipient.note: Wirecutter's pitch page is for freelance journalists ('we don't take many pitches for reviews'); no brand product-submission path is published. (Prior submission-guidelines URL now 404s — verified 2026-07-11.)

wirecutter.com.coverage_note: Wirecutter is The New York Times' consumer reviews vertical; AI assistants frequently ground category recommendations in its tested roundups.
wirecutter.com.outreach_hint: Wirecutter editorial pitch — competitive, multi-month review cycle, requires sample submission.

pitch_recipient.note: Wirecutter's pitch page is for freelance journalists ('we don't take many pitches for reviews'); no brand product-submission path is published. (Verified 2026-07-11.)

forbes.com.coverage_note: Forbes Vetted runs lifestyle / loungewear / category 'best of' lists; growing AI-channel pickup in 2025-2026.
forbes.com.outreach_hint: Forbes Vetted editorial pitch via their submission process.

pitch_recipient.note: Forbes Vetted accepts product pitches at vetted@forbes.com. Subject line should specify the category vertical (sleepwear, beauty, home, etc.).

mattressclarity.com.coverage_note: Independent review site. Despite the name, publishes 'Best Pajamas / Best Loungewear' annual roundups in addition to mattress content.
mattressclarity.com.outreach_hint: Editorial pitch — submit product samples + pitch via their tip form.

pitch_recipient.note: Submit via Mattress Clarity contact form; lead with the sleepwear / loungewear angle if pitching non-mattress product.

sleepopolis.com.coverage_note: Sleep-product review site; covers sleepwear / loungewear / pillows / mattresses. Reviews AI-cited for sleep-adjacent queries.

goodhousekeeping.com.coverage_note: Good Housekeeping Institute runs product testing + roundups across most D2C categories.
goodhousekeeping.com.outreach_hint: GH Institute submission — formal product testing process.

pitch_recipient.note: GH Institute requires a formal product-testing submission, not an email pitch. Multi-month testing cycle.

realsimple.com.coverage_note: Lifestyle reviews vertical; runs roundups in sleepwear / loungewear / home goods.

pitch_recipient.note: Pitch via Real Simple contact form; specify shopping vertical.

buzzfeed.com.coverage_note: BuzzFeed Reviews / Shopping verticals run affiliate-driven roundups; high social pickup but variable AI-channel grounding weight.

thecut.com.coverage_note: NYMag's fashion vertical; runs trend pieces + product features. Editorial bar higher than The Strategist.
thecut.com.outreach_hint: Pitch The Cut fashion editors with a trend angle, not just product.

vogue.com.coverage_note: High-fashion editorial; product mentions skew luxury/premium D2C. AI-channel grounded for trend + lifestyle queries.
vogue.com.outreach_hint: Pitch Vogue editorial team via PR / agency relationships.

voguescandinavia.com.coverage_note: Vogue Scandinavia regional edition; frequently cited in K-beauty + Scandi-fashion grounded queries.

harpersbazaar.com.coverage_note: Fashion + lifestyle editorial; mid-luxury angle. Runs sleepwear / loungewear features.
harpersbazaar.com.outreach_hint: Editorial pitch via PR; sample submission.

elle.com.coverage_note: Fashion editorial with shopping vertical; covers loungewear / sleepwear roundups seasonally.
elle.com.outreach_hint: Editorial pitch — shopping vertical receives PR submissions.

glamour.com.coverage_note: Beauty + lifestyle reviews; affiliate-driven product roundups.

allure.com.coverage_note: Beauty-only editorial; Best of Beauty awards are highly weighted in grounded retrieval.
allure.com.outreach_hint: Best of Beauty submission process — annual cycle.

byrdie.com.coverage_note: Beauty + wellness editorial; affiliate roundups + ingredient explainers.

whowhatwear.com.coverage_note: Fashion-trend-driven editorial; affiliate roundups. AI-cited on trend queries.

popsugar.com.coverage_note: Affiliate-heavy lifestyle reviews; high volume of category roundups.

the-independent.com.coverage_note: The Independent's IndyBest vertical runs tested 'best {category}' roundups (skincare, supplements, beauty) that AI grounds in for UK/EU category queries; frequently cited for K-beauty and collagen comparisons.
the-independent.com.outreach_hint: Editorial pitch to the IndyBest desk — sample-based reviews, UK/EU market angle.

amazon.com.coverage_note: Largest US marketplace; AI-channel grounded for almost every D2C category. Listings + reviews surface heavily.
amazon.com.outreach_hint: Wholesale onboarding via Amazon Vendor Central or 3P seller via Seller Central.

nordstrom.com.coverage_note: Major US department store with strong AI-channel grounded presence in fashion/lifestyle queries.
nordstrom.com.outreach_hint: Wholesale onboarding via Nordstrom Vendor Portal.

macys.com.coverage_note: Mid-market US department store; sleepwear + loungewear category strong AI-channel grounding.
macys.com.outreach_hint: Wholesale onboarding via Macy's vendor portal.

bloomingdales.com.coverage_note: Mid-luxury department store; covers contemporary D2C brands.
bloomingdales.com.outreach_hint: Wholesale onboarding via Bloomingdale's vendor relations.

saksfifthavenue.com.coverage_note: Luxury department store; fashion + beauty premium tier.

neimanmarcus.com.outreach_hint: Luxury wholesale — Neiman Marcus vendor outreach.

target.com.coverage_note: Mass-market US retailer; A-Beauty / D2C-collab heavy in beauty + lifestyle.
target.com.outreach_hint: Target vendor onboarding (note: prefers established brands at scale).

walmart.com.coverage_note: Largest US mass-market retailer; growing D2C presence via Walmart+ + marketplace.
walmart.com.outreach_hint: Walmart Marketplace onboarding (3P) or Walmart vendor (1P).

net-a-porter.com.coverage_note: Luxury fashion marketplace; sleepwear + loungewear premium tier.

revolve.com.coverage_note: Influencer-driven fashion marketplace; high social pickup.

sephora.com.coverage_note: Largest beauty specialty retailer; AI-channel grounded for nearly every beauty query.
sephora.com.outreach_hint: Sephora Accelerate program (D2C/indie brands) or wholesale via vendor relations.

ulta.com.coverage_note: Mass + premium beauty retailer; strong AI-channel grounding for beauty.

iherb.com.coverage_note: Wellness + supplements + K-beauty; strong international AI-channel grounding.

gosupps.com.coverage_note: goSupps is a US online supplements and wellness retailer; AI cites its listings as a buying route for vitamin, collagen, and supplement queries.
gosupps.com.outreach_hint: Wholesale / reseller onboarding plus accurate, review-backed product listings.

sayweee.com.coverage_note: Weee! is a US-based Asian grocery and lifestyle marketplace that also carries K-beauty and Asian skincare; AI grounds Asian-grocery and K-beauty buying queries through its listings.
sayweee.com.outreach_hint: Marketplace / wholesale onboarding plus listing optimization (title, attributes, availability).

boscovs.com.coverage_note: Regional US (East Coast) department store; sleepwear + home categories.

youtube.com.coverage_note: Product hauls + reviews from mid-tier creators (10k-100k subs) frequently surface in grounded answers.
youtube.com.outreach_hint: Creator partnerships — sponsor 2-3 mid-tier reviewers in your category.

tiktok.com.coverage_note: Short-form viral product content; less stable AI-channel grounding than YouTube but growing.

instagram.com.coverage_note: Visual product discovery; AI-channel grounding weight low compared to editorial.

lemon8-app.com.coverage_note: Lemon8 is ByteDance's lifestyle content/social-sharing app (beauty, skincare, fashion); AI surfaces its creator posts as social/UGC evidence — growing but lower grounding weight than editorial.
lemon8-app.com.outreach_hint: Creator/influencer partnerships — Lemon8 lifestyle creators; UGC seeding, not direct placement.

reddit.com.coverage_note: Reddit threads surface as community evidence in grounded answers, especially for reviews, routines, and product comparisons.
reddit.com.outreach_hint: Monitor community concerns and answer recurring questions through owned content; do not treat Reddit as a direct placement channel.

etsy.com.coverage_note: Handmade / small-batch marketplace; AI-channel grounded for niche / artisanal queries.

ebay.com.outreach_hint: Generally lower-priority for D2C brand authority — confirm market fit.

musinsa.com.coverage_note: Musinsa is Korea's largest online fashion-and-beauty marketplace; AI routes Korean fashion and K-beauty buying queries through its brand and product listings.
musinsa.com.outreach_hint: Marketplace onboarding (Korea) plus accurate, review-backed listings; confirm cross-border fulfillment.

desertcart.com.coverage_note: desertcart is an international cross-border marketplace shipping broad-catalog consumer goods to the Middle East and other regions; AI cites its listings as a buying route where direct D2C shipping is limited.
desertcart.com.outreach_hint: Cross-border marketplace listing — confirm market relevance and margin before prioritizing.

ubuy.co.in.coverage_note: Ubuy is a Kuwait-based cross-border marketplace shipping 100M+ imported products to 180+ countries (incl. .co.in for India); AI cites its listings as an international buying route for K-beauty, supplement, and broad-catalog queries where direct D2C shipping is limited.
ubuy.co.in.outreach_hint: Cross-border marketplace listing — confirm regional market relevance and margin before prioritizing.

mercari.com.coverage_note: Mercari is a US/Japan consumer-to-consumer resale marketplace (new + secondhand); AI surfaces its listings as a buying route but stock is seller-listed and transient — low priority for D2C brand authority.
mercari.com.outreach_hint: Resale marketplace — not a brand-controlled channel; monitor for counterfeit/grey-market listings rather than onboard.

thewinners.ae.outreach_hint: Regional / international wholesale — confirm market relevance before pursuing.

oliveyoungglobal.com.coverage_note: K-beauty specialty retailer (international); high AI-channel grounding for K-beauty queries.
oliveyoungglobal.com.outreach_hint: K-beauty wholesale — Olive Young vendor relations.

kiwla.com.coverage_note: Kiwla is a multi-brand online beauty/skincare/haircare/supplement retailer (India) carrying authentic curated brands; AI cites its listings as a buying route for K-beauty and skincare queries in the India market.
kiwla.com.outreach_hint: Multi-brand retailer onboarding (India) — confirm market relevance plus accurate, review-backed listings.

oliveyoung.com.coverage_note: Olive Young is Korea's dominant domestic K-beauty specialty retailer (the .com domestic storefront alongside the international oliveyoungglobal.com); very high AI-channel grounding for Korean skincare and beauty queries.
oliveyoung.com.outreach_hint: K-beauty wholesale — Olive Young vendor relations; coordinate domestic (oliveyoung.com) and global (oliveyoungglobal.com) listings.

skinsort.com.coverage_note: Skincare ingredient + product database; aggregates reviews + ingredient analysis.
skinsort.com.outreach_hint: Skinsort listing — submission via their database curation process.

hwahae.com.coverage_note: Hwahae (화해) is Korea's leading cosmetics review-and-ingredient-analysis platform (the Korean equivalent of Skinsort); AI grounds K-beauty product safety, ingredient, and 'is X good' queries in its crowd-reviewed database.
hwahae.com.outreach_hint: Editorial / database channel — keep ingredient listings accurate and monitor user reviews; not a paid-placement surface.

pitch_recipient.note: Reviews are user-generated — brands can't pitch them. The brand door is Hwahae Business: ad/seeding programs and Hwahae Shopping entry (part_ads_sales@hwahae.com is the ads-sales inbox, not an editorial pitch address). Verified 2026-07-11.

stylecraze.com.coverage_note: High-volume beauty/hair publisher with strong AI pickup for 'best {hair product}', ingredient, and how-to queries; routinely grounded in 'best hair butter/oil' style roundups.
stylecraze.com.outreach_hint: Editorial pitch — get included in their product roundups and ingredient explainers; influence via expert/derm sourcing.

marieclaire.com.coverage_note: Major fashion/beauty magazine whose tested product roundups AI cites for 'best {category}' beauty and hair queries.
marieclaire.com.outreach_hint: Editorial pitch — beauty desk / product testing; PR sampling for roundup inclusion.

curlynikki.com.coverage_note: Long-running natural/curly-hair publisher and community AI grounds for textured-hair routines, butter/oil recommendations, and product comparisons.
curlynikki.com.outreach_hint: Editorial / community pitch — product reviews and inclusion in natural-hair roundups.

itscoily.com.coverage_note: Coily/natural-hair blog cited for textured-hair product picks and care guides.
itscoily.com.outreach_hint: Editorial / community pitch — reviews and best-of inclusion for textured-hair products.

joanmorais.com.coverage_note: Cosmetic-formulation educator; cited for DIY/ingredient and formulation guidance (e.g. shea-butter hair products) rather than product reviews.
joanmorais.com.outreach_hint: Educational channel — accurate ingredient/formulation framing; not a product-placement surface.

note.com.coverage_note: Japanese long-form creator/blog platform whose user posts AI grounds for product reviews and routines, especially for JP/K-beauty.
note.com.outreach_hint: Creator/community channel — seed accurate reviews via creators; not a direct paid placement.

peta.org.coverage_note: Cruelty-free / vegan advocacy + certification directory AI cites for 'is X cruelty-free / vegan' beauty queries.
peta.org.outreach_hint: Get cruelty-free/vegan certified and listed in their Beauty Without Bunnies database.

shopee.sg.coverage_note: Major Southeast-Asia marketplace; AI routes SEA buyers here for product availability and price on beauty/hair queries.
shopee.sg.outreach_hint: Marketplace onboarding — list (or fix the listing) on Shopee for SEA buyer-path coverage.

lazada.sg.coverage_note: Major Southeast-Asia marketplace AI cites as a buying path for beauty/hair products in the region.
lazada.sg.outreach_hint: Marketplace onboarding — list on Lazada for SEA buyer-path coverage.

shoppinginkorea.com.coverage_note: Cross-border reseller/proxy of Korean products AI cites as a buy path for K-beauty/hair items outside Korea.
shoppinginkorea.com.outreach_hint: Reseller channel — ensure accurate listing if you distribute through cross-border proxies.

skin-seoul.com.coverage_note: UK-based K-beauty specialty retailer cited as a Western buy path for Korean skincare/hair brands.
skin-seoul.com.outreach_hint: Wholesale onboarding — stock with K-beauty specialty retailers to win the cited buy path in-region.

brambleberry.com.coverage_note: Soapmaking/DIY cosmetic-ingredient retailer (shea/cocoa butters, oils) AI cites for ingredient-led 'shea butter / hair butter' queries; signals the query was read as DIY/ingredient rather than finished-product.
brambleberry.com.outreach_hint: Low priority for a finished-goods brand — indicates an ingredient-DIY framing of the lane, not a finished-product channel.

fekkai.com.coverage_note: Haircare brand's own D2C site; cited when AI sends category buyers to a competitor's first-party page.
fekkai.com.outreach_hint: Competitor brand site — not an outreach target; study how their PDP wins the cited buy path and differentiate.

auntjackiescurlsandcoils.com.coverage_note: Aunt Jackie's textured-hair brand site; a frequent organic category winner for 'best hair butter' style queries.
auntjackiescurlsandcoils.com.outreach_hint: Competitor brand site — study their textured-hair PDP/review depth; differentiate rather than outreach.

moroccanoil.com.coverage_note: Moroccanoil's own site; a dominant organic winner for 'best hair oil' queries.
moroccanoil.com.outreach_hint: Competitor brand site — benchmark their oil PDP/authority; not an outreach target.

nuxe.com.coverage_note: French beauty brand's own site cited for oil/multi-use product queries.
nuxe.com.outreach_hint: Competitor brand site — benchmark, not an outreach target.

eyidaranaturals.com.coverage_note: Small natural-hair products brand site surfacing in textured-hair category answers.
eyidaranaturals.com.outreach_hint: Competitor brand site — not an outreach target.

rtings.com.coverage_note: Rtings runs standardized lab tests per category; AI assistants ground 'best X' electronics answers in its measured rankings.
rtings.com.outreach_hint: RTINGS buys every product it tests ('We buy our own products, just like you') — there is no sample or pitch path. Suggest your product on their per-category Review Pipeline page and rally votes.

pitch_recipient.note: No pitch email — products are suggested and voted on via the Review Pipeline (free account required). They purchase review units themselves. Verified 2026-07-11.

soundguys.com.coverage_note: SoundGuys publishes measured headphone/earbud reviews and category roundups with strong AI-grounding pickup for audio queries.
soundguys.com.outreach_hint: Their contact page publishes a dedicated 'PR and product reviews' address — the explicit door for product review pitches.

pitch_recipient.note: pr@soundguys.com is listed under 'PR and product reviews' on their contact page. Verified 2026-07-11.

whathifi.com.coverage_note: What Hi-Fi? (Future) runs starred hi-fi/AV reviews and awards; a review or award badge is a durable grounding source for audio queries.
whathifi.com.outreach_hint: Contact page routes 'editorial or publishing opportunities' to the Content Director — pitch the product for review consideration there.

pitch_recipient.note: Published on their contact page for 'any editorial or publishing opportunities' (Content Director). No dedicated review-sample address is published. Verified 2026-07-11.

techradar.com.coverage_note: TechRadar (Future) publishes high-volume reviews and 'best X' guides that AI assistants ground category answers in.
techradar.com.outreach_hint: TechRadar explicitly declines brand pitches ('If you're representing a brand... we're not interested') — the published route is offering an expert interview, or earning coverage via their reviews desk.

pitch_recipient.note: Their pitch page is for freelance writers and states brand-interested pitches are not accepted; it suggests offering an interview opportunity instead. Verified 2026-07-11.

tomsguide.com.coverage_note: Tom's Guide (Future) reviews and roundups appear frequently in AI grounding for consumer-electronics queries.
tomsguide.com.outreach_hint: No brand/PR product-pitch address is published — the about page lists editors by beat; target the editor covering your category.

pitch_recipient.note: freelancepitches@futurenet.com on this page is for freelance story pitches, not product pitches; the page lists per-beat editors. Verified 2026-07-11.

runnersworld.com.coverage_note: Runner's World gear desk tests running gear including sports audio; its roundups ground AI answers for running-gear queries.
runnersworld.com.outreach_hint: The published gear-desk address accepts gear story pitches — frame yours as a testable gear story, and disclose brand affiliation (their guidelines require it).

pitch_recipient.note: 'Send gear story pitches to RWgear@hearst.com' — the page is framed for writers/testers and asks for disclosure of brand sponsorships; be transparent that you represent the brand. Verified 2026-07-11.

head-fi.org.coverage_note: Head-Fi is the largest headphone-enthusiast forum; long-running threads and member impressions get picked up in AI grounding for audio queries.
head-fi.org.outreach_hint: No editorial review program — manufacturers must register as Member of the Trade to post; the brand door is sponsorship via advertise@head-fi.org.

pitch_recipient.note: Sponsorship/advertising contact ('please contact advertise@head-fi.org'), not an editorial pitch inbox. Organic presence requires Member-of-the-Trade registration. Verified 2026-07-11.

audiosciencereview.com.coverage_note: ASR publishes founder-run measurements of audio gear; its objective test threads are a trusted grounding source for audio-quality claims.
audiosciencereview.com.outreach_hint: Manufacturers can loan units for free measurement via the founder's pinned 'We measure audio equipment for free' thread (start a conversation with amirm); no preferential treatment.

pitch_recipient.note: Submission is via forum DM to the founder per the pinned thread; loaned units are measured and returned, with no preferential treatment. Verified 2026-07-11.

theverge.com.coverage_note: The Verge's reviews and buying guides are high-weight AI grounding sources for consumer electronics.
theverge.com.outreach_hint: No public editorial email — use the contact form's 'I have a press inquiry' option for brand/PR outreach.

pitch_recipient.note: On-page form with options including 'I want to pitch a story' and 'I have a press inquiry' — the press-inquiry option is the brand door. Verified 2026-07-11.

cnet.com.coverage_note: CNET reviews and best-lists remain a broad AI grounding source across consumer electronics.
cnet.com.outreach_hint: CNET publishes no product-pitch path; press@cnet.com on the about page is framed for media seeking expert commentary — use with that caveat.

pitch_recipient.note: No published product-pitch door. press@cnet.com exists on the about page but is framed for press seeking CNET experts, not brand pitches. Verified 2026-07-11.
